title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1982-09-15
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) ->Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Excellent AKG‑mic board capture that delivers a jam‑heavy set with killer Playin’/Crazy Fingers sequences and soaring Saint, despite occasional crunchiness.
ai_review.review: The recording, taken from the board with Healy’s AKG microphones, offers an unusually clear audience‑style sound for 1982, though it gets a bit crunchy on tracks like “Saint” and “N.F.A.”. Musically the show is a high‑energy romp – the Playin’ > Crazy Fingers > Playin’ thread runs through the set, highlighted by Shakedown, Red Rooster, Sailor, Saint and an early Touch of Grey – but a few moments (Bob’s slide excess, a brief pause for a bathroom break) keep it from being flawless.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave 5‑star ratings and praised the performance; minor recording quirks are noted but do not detract significantly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Board‑derived audience tape with Healy’s AKG mics; generally clear and lively, though a bit crunchy on “Saint” and “N.F.A.” and occasional analog volume compression.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Jam‑centric flow that feels like a second set, with Playin’ themes threading the first and second halves; transitions are mostly tight except for a brief lag out of Crazy Fingers.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Did not make a strong impression for one reviewer, though his guitar work is present throughout.
band_member_comments.Bob: Loved Bob’s playing overall but the slide was considered over‑done; he left Red Rooster briefly for a bathroom break.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland’s keyboard adds depth to the “auditory assault” on Red Rooster and other jams.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drummers (the Beast) were highlighted as a major strength, delivering powerful space‑filled playing.
